name: How does finish carpentry integrate into a full kitchen or bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: How does finish carpentry integrate into a full kitchen or bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Finish carpentry is an integrated phase within larger kitchen and bathroom renovations, coordinated directly alongside framing, drywall, tile, and interior painting. In a kitchen remodel, finish work includes setting crown molding on cabinetry, framing light valances, fitting window casings, and trimming baseboards around islands. In bathrooms, moisture-resistant baseboards and door casings are installed once tile backer and waterproofing steps are finished. Because HH Remodeling manages interior carpentry alongside drywall and tile directly under owner-operator Abraham Becerra, trim transitions between tile, drywall, and cabinets stay tightly coordinated without trade scheduling gaps.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finish trim is installed after drywall and tile work, tying together cabinets, doorways, and transitions with precise baseboards, casings, and moldings.
